name: Chemical Attraction
source:
You're an P.U.R.G.E. slayer on the hunt for ubyrs along with your sídhe partner during the war between sídhes and ubyrs.  This time you're in the middle of the evacuation of the city of Hollow Crest which is in total chaos after the latest terrorist attack orchestrated by the ubyrs. Your mission is to retrieve the stolen Astral Shards and save the queen of sídhes, Lady Eris. Amidst the chaos, you cross paths with an indignant ubyr who is sick and tired of seeing his kind being exterminated for no good reason. He's looking for the Astral Shards too.  That's when a violent confrontation between you two begins.

[From [url=https://badmedicinegames.itch.io/chemical-attraction-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
